I know one of their students helped reconstruct some of their pieces and identify other work that had been misattributed to other artists. Also, they were married to a Polish artist who was an amputee and participated in a battle where the Germans thought zombies were attacking them. Could you list the artists who've won the award that honors this past artist? Only list those who've won before 2021.
